features.name: mahalanobis_approx_distance
features.description: Approximate normalized distance from the training set centroid using per-feature z-score contributions summed in quadrature, providing a scale-invariant measure of how far a point is from the center of the feature space.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps KNN identify outlier points that may be far from all neighbors, improving neighborhood geometry by providing a global distance reference.

features.name: glucose_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized plasma glucose concentration, centering and scaling to unit variance for improved distance computation in KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures glucose contributes proportionally to Euclidean distance calculations, preventing scale dominance in KNN.

features.name: bmi_zscore
features.description: Z-score normalized BMI (mass), centering and scaling to unit variance for improved distance computation in KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures BMI contributes proportionally to Euclidean distance calculations, preventing scale dominance in KNN.

features.name: age_glucose_interaction_norm
features.description: Normalized interaction between age and glucose z-scores, capturing joint variation in these two clinically related features for improved neighborhood separation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures joint feature variation that may cluster similar patients together in KNN space, improving neighborhood purity.

features.name: insulin_log_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed and z-score normalized insulin level, reducing right skew before scaling to improve distance metric quality for KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the influence of extreme insulin values on distance calculations, leading to more meaningful nearest neighbor identification.

features.name: metabolic_risk_score
features.description: Composite metabolic risk score combining normalized glucose, BMI, and insulin signals into a single scalar distance-relevant feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates correlated metabolic features into a single dimension that may better separate metabolically similar patients in KNN space.

features.name: age_preg_ratio_norm
features.description: Normalized ratio of pregnancies to age, capturing reproductive history relative to age as a scale-invariant feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized ratio feature that captures demographic patterns useful for KNN neighborhood formation.

features.name: skin_bmi_similarity
features.description: Cosine-like similarity between normalized skin thickness and BMI, measuring alignment of two body composition indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures correlated body composition signals in a bounded similarity score that improves KNN distance geometry.

features.name: pedigree_age_norm_distance
features.description: Euclidean distance in the normalized pedigree-age subspace from the training centroid, capturing genetic and demographic proximity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a 2D subspace distance that captures genetic and age-related clustering patterns for KNN.

features.name: blood_pressure_deviation
features.description: Absolute deviation of blood pressure from the training mean, normalized by standard deviation, indicating how atypical the blood pressure reading is.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights patients with unusual blood pressure readings that may form distinct clusters in KNN space.

features.name: overall_metabolic_profile_similarity
features.description: Semantic assessment of how closely a patient's combined metabolic indicators (glucose, insulin, BMI) resemble a typical metabolic profile, scored from 0 (highly atypical) to 1 (very typical). Based on proximity of all three metabolic features to their respective training means within one standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic metabolic similarity score that helps KNN identify metabolically similar patients regardless of individual feature variation.

features.name: demographic_cluster_indicator
features.description: Soft cluster membership score indicating whether a patient falls into a younger low-parity demographic profile (score near 1) versus an older higher-parity profile (score near 0), based on age and pregnancy count relative to training distribution quartiles.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a soft cluster assignment that helps KNN weight neighbors from the same demographic subgroup more heavily, improving local neighborhood coherence.
